facts.fact: The National Registration (Amendment) Act 2025 (No. 7), assented 23 March 2025, amends the existing National Registration Act (Cap. 01:02); the amendment starts on a date the Minister sets by Gazette order, not yet stated.
The 2025 amendment, not yet commenced, has the registrar assign a gender-neutral identity number to each person in the Unified Population Register and issue an identity card valid 10 years.
